title: A review of water management in proton exchange membrane fuel cell systems
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2024, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01020E, Review Article
Peihan Qi, Zhenxing Wu, Jiegang Mou, Denghao Wu, Yunqing Gu, Maosen Xu, Zekai Li, Yang Luo
Water management has been an unavoidable problem for proton exchange membrane fuel cells (PEMFCs), and effective water management measures can improve the performance and extend the lifespan of the PEMFC.
